 I found 10 Amazon deals offering entirely new low prices ahead of Black Friday
 By Rikka Altland , CNN Underscored
 Published
 11:29 AM EST, Wed November 4, 2026
 Link Copied!
 Suzanne Kattau/CNN Underscored 
 Black Friday is quickly approaching, and like it does every other week, Amazon has refreshed its sale section with a fresh batch of discounts. After combing through the clearance page and its thousands of new markdowns, I spotted some deals that are actually worth shopping ahead of Thanksgiving week. It would be so much easier if you could find the best deals all on one handy landing page, but Amazon tends to hide its most enticing offers — like the ones you’ll find below.
 Finding deals that match previous record-setting markdowns is easy, but that’s not the case for offers that are selling for less than ever before. So this week, I found 10 products that have landed at entirely new all-time low prices, including a hybrid space heater and cooling fan from Dyson, an All-Clad sauté pan fit for assisting with your Thanksgiving feast and a DeWalt power tool package that the weekend warrior on your gift list will love. All that and more below.
 Dyson Hot+Cool HP1 Purifier Heater and Fan 
 32% off 
 Amazon 
 Dyson's recently released combination heater and cooling fan has only been on sale a handful of times in the past. Even the best of those previous markdowns haven't dropped below $500, with today's offer now beating the last deal by an extra $50. Whether you plan to use it for heating this fall and winter or cooling come next year, it'll also purify the air while it regulates the temperature of your space. Best of all? Today's 32% discount results in an entirely new low price. 
 $660 
 $450 at Amazon
 First-Time Deal 
 All-Clad 4-Quart HA1 Expert Nonstick Sauté Pan 
 20% off 
 Amazon 
 The first and only Amazon discount on this new nonstick sauté pan has arrived just in time to help you prepare that massive feast come Thanksgiving. Use it to sauté vegetables, make some deliciously crispy potatoes or even put its larger 4-quart volume to use as a cake pan. No matter how you plan to cook with it, the pan's 20% discount is the lowest price you'll find now or any time in the past, for that matter.
 $150 
 $120 at Amazon
 DeWalt 20V Max Brushless Power Tool Set 
 33% off 
 Amazon 
 DeWalt makes the best power drill our editors have tried for tackling home improvement projects. Its other tools are just as capable for helping out with renovations, and this week, the brand's three-tool set went on sale at Amazon just in time for you to gift to the aspiring Tim “The Toolman” Taylor on your list. After digging into the pricing history, I found that it's an extra $31 below the only other two discounts that have arrived before today's sale, and like everything else on this list, an entirely new low price. It includes a power drill, impact driver and oscillating multitool alongside three batteries and a charger.
 $399 
 $269 at Amazon
 Twelve South AirFly Pro 2 
 23% off 
 Amazon 
 Twelve South’s AirFly audio transmitters have earned permanent spots in the travel bags of several CNN Underscored editors, including mine! I won't fly without one tucked away in my carry-on item for using the headphones or earbuds I already own to watch movies and TV shows on an airplane's seat-back screen without giving up higher sound quality and noise cancellation. Previous discounts on the adapter have taken as much as 20% off the usual price tag, like you would have found during October Prime Day. But now you can take an extra $2 off the price tag in select colors to score an entirely new low price.
 $60 
 From $46 at Amazon
 First-Time Deal 
 Breville BOV900BTR Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro 
 20% off 
 Amazon 
 The previous generation of this toaster oven was crowned the champion when we put it to the test against the other best smart ovens . Everything we loved about the older version, including its spatial cooking capability, large LCD screen and intuitive control knobs, makes a return on the latest model alongside new additions. This version has a larger capacity than its older counterpart and now has two additional cooking modes. Today's discount is the first chance to save on the Black Truffle and brushed stainless steel finishes.
 $400 
 $320 at Amazon
 Garmin Vívoactive 5 Smartwatch 
 43% off 
 Garmin 
 Now $4 under the previous low price from the greater Labor Day shopping season, this fitness tracker can help you nail personal fitness goals, improve your sleep and keep an eye on your overall well-being. So whether you're inspired by this past weekend's New York City Marathon or you just want to pay a little extra attention to your health, Garmin's smartwatch has you covered. My favorite part is that Garmin offers some of the most unique watch faces on the market, which recently include some Pikachu-, Charmander- and Snorlax-themed options after partnering with Pokémon Sleep .
 $300 
 $170 at Amazon
 iRobot Roomba Plus 415 Robot Vacuum & Mop Combo 
 37% off 
 Amazon 
 Thanksgiving may still be several weeks away, but I am sure that you could use a little break from the chaos of planning that family gathering. Instead of having to worry about making sure your home is spotless before guests arrive on top of coordinating each dinner course, you can offload the work to this robotic vacuum and mop. iRobot's new Roomba Plus 415 takes care of the cleaning for you, and for less than ever before with today's discount. It's only the third chance to save since launching earlier in the year and undercuts both of the prior sales by an extra $120 to earn a spot in Amazon's early Black Friday event.
 $600 
 $380 at Amazon
 Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) 
 45% off 
 Amazon 
 Only the second discount to date, today's markdown on these over-ear headphones is a new low price. The first chance to save was a 10% discount, so saying that this markdown is better isn't necessarily all that impressive until you see how steep of a sale it is. Amazon is taking 45% off all four colors. I've tried dozens of new over-ear headphones in 2026, and the newest pair from Bose might just be one of the best values of the bunch with solid sound quality and reliable active noise cancellation.
 $359 
 $199 at Amazon
 Philips Norelco i9000 Electric Shaver in Adriatic Blue 
 48% off 
 Amazon 
 The lowest this electric razor has sold before today's sale was $170, and that was back during the Black Friday and Cyber Monday festivities last year. Now as this year's holiday shopping season approaches, the grooming essential is an extra $40 below any discount that has come before it. The shaver is entirely waterproof for wet and dry shaving, even in the shower, and comes with a ton of added accessories to help ensure you can get the perfect shave.
 $250 
 $130 at Amazon
 LG 65-Inch G5 OLED TV (2025) 
 27% off 
 Amazon 
 This TV may be last year's version of the LG, but it's the best value around for anyone who is in search of an OLED model. The previous record-setting discount was $1,700 in 2025, but the least you'd have paid in 2026 (up until today) would have been $1,800. Today's offer saves you a total of $600, beats the previous best price of the year by $200 and is $100 below anything else I've tracked since it was first released last spring. In our editors' eyes, LG makes the best OLED TVs around, with sharp picture quality, a super-bright panel, vibrant colors and dark black hues.
 $2,200 
 $1,600 at Amazon
 Why these Amazon deals are worth shopping
 Every week, Amazon drops hundreds of new discounts on practically every product category it carries. Sifting through row after row of digital store shelves to find the best deals isn’t everyone’s idea of a fun time, so let me put in the work for you. After shopping around, comparing prices against other retailers and checking pricing history, I found 10 enticing offers worth adding to your cart.
 I’m constantly tracking price cuts across multiple online storefronts to ensure the deals are as good as retailers say. The rest of t﻿he deals team and I dive into each product’s price history while cross-referencing reviews and guides from other CNN Underscored editors to determine if it’s worth the spend.
 Why trust CNN Underscored
 CNN Underscored’s deals editors scour the internet daily for the best available sales and discounts, then put them on your radar in real time. They utilize a range of techniques and consider a variety of factors — price history checks, available coupon codes, competitor pricing — to determine if a deal is worthy of coverage (and your money).
 For this article, CNN Underscored senior deals editor Rikka Altland combed through pages of deals to find the best discounts at Amazon this week. Altland has been doing just that for over a decade, and that kind of experience extends to the rest of our deals team. Being an advocate for buyers, ensuring we only recommend the best prices on the best products, is what we’re all about, and that focus comes through in our work.
 Rikka Altland 
 Senior Editor, Deals 
 Rikka Altland is CNN Underscored’s senior deals editor. Using her nearly decade of experience in the space, she covers all things discounts and savings as well as product launches on the latest reveals and gadgets. You’ll find Altland exploring trendy new restaurants or cheering at Rangers games.
